column1: Events after the End of the Reporting Period

column2: 81.  Events after the end of the reporting period are those events that occur between the end of the reporting period  and
the date when the financial statements are authorized for issue.

column1: Adjusting events after the end of the reporting period

column2: 82.  A Pradeshiya Sabha shall adjust the amounts recognized in its financial statements, or recognize items that were not
previously recognized, including related disclosures, to reflect adjusting events after the end of the reporting period.
